title: Temporal Evidence Integrity & Apify Fail-Closed Hardening
commit_message: fix(reliability): prevent stale ad observations and unsafe Apify retries

defects_resolved.name: False Fresh Ad Observations
defects_resolved.root_cause: create_daily_snapshot() copied Advertisement.is_active into today's snapshot without external source provenance. _compute_product_daily_metric() fell back to historic Advertisement.is_active when active snapshots were zero, fabricating artificial active momentum.
remediation: Added observation_quality column to advertisement_snapshots table with database index.

Ran migration on winhunter.db: 145 T0 baseline snapshots classified as GENUINE_SOURCE_OBSERVATION, 290 analytical/derived snapshots classified as DATABASE_DERIVED_SNAPSHOT. All 145 unique ads preserved.
create_daily_snapshot() requires collection_run_id or observed_ad_statuses for GENUINE_SOURCE_OBSERVATION. Analytical calls create DATABASE_DERIVED_SNAPSHOT.
Removed stale fallback in _compute_product_daily_metric(): active_ad_count counts strictly GENUINE_SOURCE_OBSERVATION active ads; zero confirmed active ads remains zero.
In scheduler.py, Step 1 skips snapshot creation during analytical cycles unless a fresh Meta collection run completed.

defects_resolved.name: Database Budget Lock Must Fail Closed
defects_resolved.root_cause: _acquire_db_lock() caught all exceptions and logged a warning while proceeding with unlocked transactions, risking duplicate Actor launches and overspend.
remediation: Verified apify_budget_locks table existence before locking; raises BudgetLockError if absent.
Refuses reservation immediately on SQLite lock contention, busy states, or DB errors without swallowing exceptions.

defects_resolved.name: Ambiguous Actor Start Failures
defects_resolved.root_cause: Starting an Actor run returning non-200/201 or network errors released reservation to FAILED with $0.00 and continued to next Actor. Missing usageTotalUsd defaulted to $0.00.
remediation: Separated definitive client rejections (HTTP 4xx: 400, 401, 403, 404, 422) from ambiguous server errors (HTTP 5xx, timeouts, drops).
Ambiguous server errors, response JSON decode errors, and responses missing data.id transition to NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, retain full reserved budget cap, and halt (break) sequence.
Definitive 4xx client errors reconcile to FAILED with $0.00 and break on fatal auth errors (401, 403).
In billing check, missing or None usageTotalUsd retains reserved budget_cap rather than assuming verified $0.00.
